title: Data centre critical power loss
goal: Show quantified failure logic for redundant UPS modules and upstream electrical sources.

rubric.must: A top event labelled Critical IT load de-energised is visibly at the head of the tree.
The tree visibly shows two UPS module failures at an AND gate.
The picture visibly separates utility feeder and standby generator failures.
Every leaf-level basic event visibly carries a plausible probability.
OR and AND gate symbols visibly distinguish the stated failure logic.
A computed probability or cut-set summary is visible without obscuring the tree.

ideal.notes: Independently authored against visual-eval/exemplars/faulttree/ideal.svg (sha256 7bffbe71b8bd), source sha256 dc3d140f24aa. Independent top-down fault tree, exact boolean-state enumeration and minimal cut-set extraction, slate event boxes, green AND/OR/INHIBIT gates, blue probabilities. Output stems and the single-child inhibit connection corrected following visual inspection; all declared conditions and basic probabilities retained. All 21 risk-batch targets were rasterised with Resvg and visually inspected individually on 2026-09-14; this drawing was accepted for geometry, label readability and semantic traceability.
